expected: requirements.txt pins sqlalchemy-cubrid to at least 1.2.3, the recipe's printed Requirements: line and its golden state the same floor, and SUPPORT_MATRIX.md ties that floor to the async recipe. Whether the recipe runs on that floor is only shown by installing it and running make verify against a live CUBRID.
non_goals: no change to the sync recipes' floors or to the README badge
problem: fundamentals/async/02_async_sqlalchemy.py builds an AsyncEngine with cubrid+aiopycubrid://, but that async dialect is first installable from PyPI in sqlalchemy-cubrid 1.2.3. The recipe's requirements.txt, its printed Requirements: line and the matching golden all advertise sqlalchemy-cubrid>=1.0. Correct the floor everywhere it is stated and document in the support matrix that the async recipe needs more than the sync recipes.
title: State the sqlalchemy-cubrid floor the async recipe really needs
